title: PCI Express Base Specification Revision 4.0 Version 1.0 (27 September 2017)

clauses.paraphrase: An aligned receiver searches EIEOS until SDS establishes Locked state. Locked state forbids alignment adjustment; variable SKP boundary changes still apply. Invalid sync headers leave locked alignment.
SDS marks entry into a data stream. Permitted LTSSM contexts and following-data requirements are outside this leaf.

corroboration.scope: Primary instrument-vendor appnote identifies SDS as return-to-L0 marker after training; not authority for literal bytes.

local_contract: raw_i[0] arrives first; low payload byte is earliest. Each block carries its two sync bits.

Accept exact full aligned 130-bit SDS only. Set local locked_o on the same sampling edge as block_valid_o/sds_o; gate every following raw-word EIEOS acquisition immediately, independent of external search remaining enabled.
SDS DATA-header alias, corruption and partial capture do not establish lock. Search control can suppress acquisition without suppressing already-aligned SDS classification.
Every accepted exact aligned EIEOS is classified by eieos_o. After SDS it never asserts realign_o or adjusts the bit boundary.
Reset, force_realign, raw-valid gap or detected malformed boundary/header clears lock. Loss/fault propagation beyond this recovered-clock leaf is external.
Variable66/98/130/162/194-bit SKP extraction remains identical; no insertion/deletion, deskew, CDC, LTSSM or full-PCS qualification.
